text: The DAO design requires that the value of the tokens staked on a set of policies be large enough to cover the maximum possible liability on those policies, which in turn imposes a minimum condition on the premium charged.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
abstract: The design of the DAO requires that v1 should be large enough to cover the maximum possible liability on the M policies against which these tokens are to be encumbered. We will later derive a condition on the premium

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: steady state model with constant M and p
